name: The Facility
source:
You play as Skye Blee, a 22 year old woman living in a cheap apartment with few luxuries and little hope. A few weeks ago you contacted a place known simply as The Facility.

The Facility recruits people like you for a two week training period. After two weeks you're given the choice to leave or stay with them. Now one of their people is coming to take you there. If you agree to go with her, you'll gain access to a life of safety, luxury, and sexual pleasure. However you'll also be hypnotized and trained to become a sex slave.

[From [url=http://www.hypnopics-collective.net/smf_forum/index.php?topic=22261.0]Official thread[/url]]

The visual novel is a direct continuation of Allister Remm's erotic stories "[url=http://mcstories.com/JustRelaxAndLook/index.html]Just Relax and Look at the Light[/url]" and "[url=http://mcstories.com/FacilityAllisterRemm/index.html]The Facility[/url]".
translation:
你扮演Skye Blee，一位22岁的女性，住在一套廉价公寓里，没有什么奢侈品，也没有什么希望。几周前，你联系了一个简称为“设施”的地方。

该机构招募像你这样的人进行为期两周的培训。两周后，你可以选择离开或留在他们身边。现在他们的一个人要带你去那里。如果你同意和她一起去，你将获得安全、奢华和性愉悦的生活。然而，你也会被催眠并接受训练成为性奴隶。

[来自[url=http://www.hypnopics-collective.net/smf_forum/index.php?topic=22261.0]官方线程[/url]]

这部视觉小说是阿利斯特·雷姆的色情故事“[url=http://mcstories.com/JustRelaxAndLook/index.html]Just Relax and Look at the Light[/url]”和“[url=http://mcstories.com/FacilityAllisterRemm/index.html]The Facility[/url]”的直接延续。
